problems.detail: Advisory locks are sorted within one stop, not across a create's stops. A trips.create whose stop 1 carries bill B and stop 2 bill A, racing a stops.add of [A,B], takes the locks in opposite order and can deadlock (Postgres 40P01). No 40P01 or deadlock handling exists in core/platform or database/src/client.ts, so it likely surfaces as a 500 (not executed). Two creates cannot hit this: both upsert the numbering series row (platform/numbering.ts onConflictDoUpdate) before insertStop, so they serialise. The code matches the amendment's letter (per stop, deduped, sorted). A follow-up could lock the whole create's bills up front.

While the W7 board query is still loading or has failed, `unplanned` is an empty set, so packOnTrip falls back to the shop-level check. The amendment only allows that fallback beyond the board's page. In that window a second, unplanned packed bill of an on-trip shop is selectable, and Build would include it. Once the board loads, `picked` re-filters at render, so the gap is timing-only.

The planned e2e script was not written because the lane forbids edits under QA/. So the UI-layer proofs the verdict asks for were not executed: the lost-reply replay on POST /delivery/trips, the W7 not-on-trip and second-bill sentences visible in secondary, enabled rows reading 'Packed …', and the accountant's M7 view. Only the pure lib tests pin retry-stable ids and packOnTrip.
READMEs were not regenerated for GET /delivery/trip-planning (the lane forbids pnpm docs:readme), so `pnpm docs:readme:check` fails until the main session regenerates them on the merged tree.

The web 1280x800 and 390x844, Android Pixel_7_API_36 and iOS walks, and `pnpm smoke --service warehouse`, were not run (the lane forbids dev servers, emulators and simulators). By code reading, native ListRow renders `secondary` for disabled rows (native/list.tsx:170-173). Every form is an inline Panel with page-level Dialogs; no Sheet is used.
W7 trip rows print the raw state enum in secondary (`${shortDate(row.tripDate)} · ${row.state}`) rather than a translated word. Cosmetic.
